<SPAN 1>THIS AGREEMENT is made on [Insert the date you all sign the agreement].</SPAN 1>
<SPAN 2>BETWEEN:</SPAN 2>
<SPAN 3>(1) [Insert your company name] incorporated under the laws of Belgium with company number [Insert registered company number] whose registered office is at [Insert address]; and</SPAN 3>
<SPAN 4>(2) [Insert the company name of the other company] incorporated under the law of [Belgium OR insert relevant jurisdiction] with company number [Insert registered company number] whose registered office is at [Insert address].</SPAN 4>
<SPAN 5>BACKGROUND:</SPAN 5>
<SPAN 6>The parties wish to exchange confidential information for the purpose of considering a potential collaboration between their respective businesses.</SPAN 6>
<SPAN 7>IT IS AGREED:</SPAN 7>
<SPAN 8>1. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION</SPAN 8>
<SPAN 9>1.1 </SPAN 9><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 10>The words defined below shall have the following meaning:</SPAN 10>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"matched"],[2,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 11>"Confidential Information" means all confidential information (however recorded, preserved or disclosed) disclosed or made available by the Discloser or any of its Representatives to the Recipient or any of its Representatives including but not limited to:</SPAN 11>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"neighbour"],[2,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 12>(a) any information that is marked, or at the time of disclosure is otherwise designated, as being confidential;</SPAN 12>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"neighbour"],[2,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 13>(b) any information that would be regarded as confidential by a reasonable business person on or relating to:</SPAN 13>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 14>(i) the business, affairs, customers, clients, suppliers, plans, intentions, or market opportunities of the Discloser; or</SPAN 14>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-agreement-solicitation-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 15>(ii) the operations, processes, products, techniques and specifications, test procedures and results, inventions, know-how, trade secrets, designs or software of the Discloser;</SPAN 15>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-agreement-solicitation-v1":[[0,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 16>(c) the fact that discussions and negotiations are taking place concerning the Purpose and the status of those discussions and negotiations;</SPAN 16>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-agreement-solicitation-v1":[[0,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 17>(d) the existence and terms of this agreement; and</SPAN 17>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-agreement-solicitation-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 18>(e) any information or analysis derived from any of the Confidential Information.</SPAN 18>
<SPAN 19>"Discloser" means a party to this agreement which discloses or makes available directly or indirectly Confidential Information.</SPAN 19>
<SPAN 20>"Purpose" means considering whether or not to enter into a business collaboration between the parties and putting into place the arrangements for that collaboration.</SPAN 20>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 21>"Recipient" means a party to this agreement that receives or obtains directly or indirectly Confidential Information.</SPAN 21>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[0,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 22>"Representative" means, in relation to a party, that party's employees, agents, accountants and lawyers.</SPAN 22>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 23>1.2 </SPAN 23><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 24>A person includes a natural person, corporate or unincorporated body (whether or not having separate legal personality) and that person's legal and personal representatives, successors and permitted assigns.</SPAN 24>
<SPAN 25>1.3 </SPAN 25><SPAN 26>Any schedule(s) form part of this agreement and shall have effect as if set out in full in the body of this agreement. </SPAN 26><SPAN 27>Any reference to this agreement includes the schedule(s). </SPAN 27><SPAN 28>Any obligation in this agreement on a person not to do something includes an obligation not to allow that thing to be done.</SPAN 28>
<SPAN 29>2. COMPLIANCE WITH THIS AGREEMENT</SPAN 29>
<SPAN 30>In consideration of the Discloser or any of its Representatives disclosing or making available Confidential Information to the Recipient or any of its Representatives, the Recipient, on behalf of itself and its Representatives, undertakes to comply with the terms of this agreement. </SPAN 30><SPAN 31>The Recipient shall, at all times, be liable for the failure of any of its Representatives to comply with the terms of this agreement.</SPAN 31>
<SPAN 32>3. OBLIGATIONS OF CONFIDENTIALITY</SPAN 32>
<SPAN 33>3.1 </SPAN 33><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-limited-use-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 34>The Recipient shall keep the Discloser's Confidential Information confidential and, except with the prior written consent of the Discloser or as expressly permitted by this agreement, shall:</SPAN 34>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[2,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-limited-use-v1":[[0,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 35>3.1.1 not use the Confidential Information except for the Purpose;</SPAN 35>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[2,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-limited-use-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 36>3.1.2 not disclose or make available the Confidential Information in whole or in part to any third party;</SPAN 36>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[0,"neighbour"],[2,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 37>3.1.3 not make any copies, reduce to writing or otherwise record the Confidential Information in whole or in part except as strictly necessary for the Purpose (and any such copies, reductions to writing and records shall be the property of the Discloser);</SPAN 37>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[0,"neighbour"],[2,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 38>3.1.4 keep the Confidential Information in a safe and secure place and establish and maintain adequate security measures to safeguard the Confidential Information from unauthorised access or use, including but not limited to implementing any reasonable security measures proposed by the Discloser from time to time; and</SPAN 38>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[0,"matched"],[2,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 39>3.1.5 at the written request of the Discloser, or in any event on termination of this agreement, return or destroy all documents or other records containing Confidential Information to the Discloser and confirm to the Discloser that it has done so in writing.</SPAN 39>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 40>3.2 </SPAN 40><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 41>The obligations in clause 3.1 shall not apply any information that:</SPAN 41>
<SPAN 42>3.2.1 is or becomes available to the Recipient or the public other than as a result of its disclosure by the Recipient or its Representatives in breach of this agreement or any other obligation of confidence owed by the Recipient or its Representatives to the Discloser;</SPAN 42>
<SPAN 43>3.2.2 the Recipient can establish was lawfully in the possession of or available on a non-confidential basis to the Recipient before the information was disclosed to it by the Discloser; or</SPAN 43>
<SPAN 44>3.2.3 the parties agree in writing may be disclosed.</SPAN 44>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 45>4. PERMITTED DISCLOSURES</SPAN 45>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 46>4.1 </SPAN 46><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 47>The Recipient may disclose all or part of the Discloser's Confidential Information to a Representative who needs to know that particular Confidential Information for the Purpose provided that, in relation to each Representative to whom the Discloser's Confidential Information is to be disclosed, the Recipient prior to disclosure:</SPAN 47>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 48>4.1.1 informs the Representative of the confidential nature of the Confidential Information;</SPAN 48>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 49>4.1.2 informs the Discloser of the identity of the Representative to whom it intends to disclose Confidential Information;</SPAN 49>
<SPAN 50>4.1.3 procures that the Representative shall, in relation to any Confidential Information disclosed, comply with this agreement as if it were the Recipient; and</SPAN 50>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 51>4.1.4 if the Discloser so requests, in relation to a Representative other than an employee of the Recipient, procures that such Representative enters into a confidentiality agreement with the Discloser on terms equivalent to those contained in this agreement.</SPAN 51>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 52>4.2 </SPAN 52><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"matched"]],"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 53>The Recipient or its Representatives may disclose the Discloser's Confidential Information to the extent such Confidential Information is required to be disclosed by law, by any governmental or other regulatory authority, or by a court or other authority of competent jurisdiction provided that, to the extent it is legally permitted to do so, the Recipient or its Representatives give the Discloser as much notice of this disclosure as possible and, where notice of disclosure is not prohibited and is given in accordance with this clause 4.2, it takes into account the reasonable requests of the Discloser in relation to the content of this disclosure.</SPAN 53>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 54>5. OTHER MATTERS</SPAN 54>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[0,"matched"]],"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 55>5.1 All Confidential Information shall remain the property of the party disclosing it, which reserves all rights in its Confidential Information. </SPAN 55><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[0,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 56>No rights, including, but not limited to, any and all intellectual property rights, in respect of a party's Confidential Information are granted to the other party.</SPAN 56>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 57>5.2 Neither party makes any express or implied warranty or representation concerning its Confidential Information, including without limitation the accuracy or completeness of its Confidential Information.</SPAN 57>
<SPAN 58>5.3 </SPAN 58><SPAN 59>The disclosure of Confidential Information by a party shall not form any offer by, or representation or warranty on the part of, that party to enter into any further agreement in relation to the Purpose.</SPAN 59>
<SPAN 60>5.4 </SPAN 60><SPAN 61>The parties each acknowledge that damages alone would not be an adequate remedy for the breach of any of the provisions of this agreement. </SPAN 61><SPAN 62>Accordingly, without prejudice to any other rights and remedies it may have, each party shall be entitled to seek the granting of equitable relief (including without limitation injunctive relief) concerning any threatened or actual breach of any of the provisions of this agreement.</SPAN 62>
<SPAN 63>6. SUCCESSORS AND ASSIGNMENT</SPAN 63>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 64>This agreement shall be binding on and endure for the benefit of each party's successors and personal representatives but shall not be assignable at law or otherwise without the prior written consent of the parties.</SPAN 64>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 65>7. TERM AND TERMINATION</SPAN 65>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 66>If either party decides not to continue to be involved in the Purpose with the other party it shall notify the other party in writing and this agreement will terminate with immediate effect. </SPAN 66><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[1,"matched"]],"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 67>The obligations of each party shall continue for a period of [Insert number of years - this should be a realistic estimate of how long it is likely that the information that is to be disclosed will remain important to protect, e.g. </SPAN 67><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 68>5] years from the termination of this agreement. </SPAN 68><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 69>Termination of this agreement shall not affect any accrued rights or remedies to which either party is entitled.</SPAN 69>
<SPAN 70>8. DEEMED DELIVERY</SPAN 70>
<SPAN 71>8.1 </SPAN 71><SPAN 72>Any notice to be given in connection with this agreement shall be in writing in English and shall either be delivered by hand or sent by first class post or fax, email or other electronic form:</SPAN 72>
<SPAN 73>8.1.1 to any company which is a party at its registered office (or such other address as it may notify to the other parties to this agreement for such purpose); or</SPAN 73>
<SPAN 74>8.1.2 to any individual who is a party at the address of that individual shown on page 1 of this agreement;</SPAN 74>
<SPAN 75>(or in each such case such other address as the recipient may notify to the other parties for such purpose).</SPAN 75>
<SPAN 76>8.2 </SPAN 76><SPAN 77>A communication sent according clause 8.1 shall be deemed to have been received:</SPAN 77>
<SPAN 78>8.1.1 if delivered by hand, at the time of delivery;</SPAN 78>
<SPAN 79>8.1.2 if sent by pre-paid first class post, on the second day after posting; or</SPAN 79>
<SPAN 80>8.1.3 if sent by fax, email or other electronic form, at the time of completion of transmission by the sender.</SPAN 80>
<SPAN 81>9. ENTIRE AGREEMENT AND VARIATION</SPAN 81>
<SPAN 82>9.1 </SPAN 82><SPAN 83>This agreement and the documents referred to or incorporated in it constitute the entire agreement between the parties relating to the subject matter of this agreement and supersedes and extinguishes any prior drafts, agreements, undertakings, representations, warranties and arrangements of any nature whatsoever, whether or not in writing, between the parties in relation to the subject matter of this agreement.</SPAN 83>
<SPAN 84>9.2 </SPAN 84><SPAN 85>Each of the parties acknowledges and agrees that it has not entered into this agreement in reliance on any statement or representation of any person (whether a party to this agreement or not) other than as expressly incorporated in this agreement.</SPAN 85>
<SPAN 86>9.3 </SPAN 86><SPAN 87>Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, each of the parties irrevocably and unconditionally waives any right or remedy it may have to claim damages and/or to rescind this agreement by reason of any misrepresentation (other than a fraudulent misrepresentation) having been made to it by any person (whether party to this agreement or not) and upon which it has relied in entering into this agreement.</SPAN 87>
<SPAN 88>9.4 </SPAN 88><SPAN 89>Without prejudice to clause 5.4, each of the parties acknowledges and agrees that the only cause of action available to it under the terms of this agreement and the documents referred to or incorporated in this agreement shall be for breach of contract.</SPAN 89>
<SPAN 90>9.5 </SPAN 90><SPAN 91>Nothing contained in this agreement or in any other document referred to or incorporated in it shall be read or construed as excluding any liability or remedy as a result of fraud.</SPAN 91>
<SPAN 92>9.6 </SPAN 92><SPAN 93>No variation of this agreement or any of the documents in the agreed form shall be valid unless it is in writing and signed by or on behalf of each of the parties to this agreement.</SPAN 93>
<SPAN 94>10. NO WAIVER</SPAN 94>
<SPAN 95>Failure to exercise, or any delay in exercising, any right or remedy provided under this agreement or by law shall not constitute a waiver of that or any other right or remedy, nor shall it preclude or restrict any further exercise of that or any other right or remedy. </SPAN 95><SPAN 96>No single or partial exercise of any right or remedy provided under this agreement or by law shall preclude or restrict the further exercise of that or any other right or remedy.</SPAN 96>
<SPAN 97>11. PARTNERSHIP</SPAN 97>
<SPAN 98>Nothing in this agreement is intended or shall be construed as establishing or implying any partnership of any kind between the parties.</SPAN 98>
<SPAN 99>12. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION</SPAN 99>
<SPAN 100>12.1 </SPAN 100><SPAN 101>This agreement and any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with it or its subject matter or formation including non-contractual disputes or claims shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Belgium.</SPAN 101>
<SPAN 102>12.2 Each party irrevocably agrees to submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Belgium over any claim or matter arising under or in connection with this agreement.</SPAN 102>
<SPAN 103>13. COUNTERPARTS</SPAN 103>
<SPAN 104>This agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts each of which when executed by one or more of the parties hereto shall constitute an original but all of which shall constitute one and the same instrument.</SPAN 104>
<SPAN 105>Agreed on by the below-mentioned parties and drawn up in as many originals as there are parties. </SPAN 105><SPAN 106>Each party declares that it has received one original.</SPAN 106>
<SPAN 107>Signed for and on behalf of [INSERT NAME </SPAN 107><SPAN 108>)</SPAN 108>
